reviewed: Field notes assembled October 2, 2026. Community-reported mechanics; Season 5 live verification incomplete.

tips.text: Break the four Soul Vessels before attacking the boss. Plan your route so destroyed vessels do not trap you in pools.
Under 90% boss health, leave room to kite Spirit Decay. Chasing circles make stationary damage rotations risky.
Necrotic Wave returns. Crossing behind the boss avoids betting your life on a gap between overlapping waves.

tips.text: Leave the charging slam circle before Absorbing Chaos finishes. A long cast can outlast the safe damage window.
Avoid Cursing Scythe's bolts. Curse of Aberroth lowers resistances and is reported as uncleansable; a cleanse is not the answer to those stacks.
In the final phase, budget two movements: escape Cosmic Absorption, then leave the following beam's aim.

tips.text: Shockwave is a two-hit sequence. Start away from the first slam, then cross only after it lands to avoid the second side.
Use Burning Amber on the Pyres promptly. Shortening this phase reduces the number of Shockwave sequences you must survive.
Keep a clear landing spot for Rock Fall. The sweeping root wall can interrupt a last-second escape.

tips.text: Reposition across from Spore Beam as it starts. Higher tiers can make the sweeping coverage harder to outrange.
Keep a cleanse ready for Poison from Energy Wave. Its quadrant can overlap the route you chose to avoid the beam.
Clear Titanflesh when the boss gives you room. Fewer small hits make recovery between major attacks more effective.

tips.text: Use Soulfire Shield to match the active floor hazard. Do not try to compensate for the wrong immunity with ordinary gear alone.
Check for lingering Ignite before changing away from Fire immunity. Cleanse it so the switch does not expose you to an existing burn.
Give a summoned Thrall room to burst. Marked for Death can make subsequent damage worse even after you avoid the first hit.

tips.text: Leave Siege Bolt's marked area before returning to damage. Leveling gear is not a reason to gamble on its large hit.
Do not let Stone Stare reach four stacks. Arrange a usable cleanse before the attempt, not after losing control.
Favor positions that leave a pool-free escape route. Move again when the marker or stare makes that position unsafe.

tips.text: This phase switches to Physical pressure. Plan recovery between melee hits rather than relying on the phase-one resistance setup.
Blood Pools and melee can shred armor. Avoid the pools and do not assume your standing armor value survives the fight unchanged.
Back away when pools are recalled for Corrupting Bomb. Do not stay beside her to finish a damage rotation.

tips.text: Void is a baseline threat; the variant adds another element. Check the actual variant before choosing a resistance swap.
For Void Meteor, read its path and leave the lane. Moving along the lane can keep you in danger despite covering distance.
Remove Blood Effigy before its damage ramps. Persistent Starburst and Black Hole areas also need room in your movement plan.

tips.text: Plan meteor dodges around both the incoming path and the landing area. The floor remains a threat after the initial impact.
Avoid unnecessary chip hits that stack resistance reduction. Do not assume your character-sheet cap is the resistance active mid-fight.
New Omens change the threat mix. Keep persistent pools together so the next phase still has usable movement space.
